owner: original-agent:commercial (#116 original research; #138 original identity consumer; existing composer/outreach)
root_cause: The original public-company source reader rejected every HTML page whose declared or streamed body exceeded 160kB, preventing bounded evidence extraction. The original held composer always inspected only the first 50 priority waiting actions, allowing eligible source-verified later rows to starve. Neither is proof of a real new address or recipient authority.
corrective_action: Allow first 160kB of a large public HTML page to be inspected within the original worker, preserve SOURCE_HTML_TRUNCATED_UNVERIFIED as retriable if no independently named work-mailto found, and scan four capped stable pages of the original waiting composer view; preserve provider/consent/outcome safeguards.
prevention_rule: An oversized or partial website is never COMPLETE without actual identity-bound source proof; a composer may not starve eligible original waiting actions at a fixed top-50 offset; no expired action may be automatically reauthorized, no send/consumer/learning claim without independent proof.
rollback: Revert only both scoped Edge logic changes via protected PR; preserve original source-action IDs, pending retries and provider/consent records. No direct cron or send mutation.
